categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Haid Group primarily operates in the animal feed industry, producing and selling aquatic and livestock feed, premium aquatic animal seedlings, animal health products, and biological products. The company also engages in pig and aquatic product farming, covering research, design, production, sales, and services across the entire supply chain. Its business segments include feed production, animal health products, farming operations, trade of raw materials, and corporate support functions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in animal genetics and breeding, animal nutrition and feed formulation, veterinary medicine and biopharmaceuticals, microbial engineering, biochemistry, and protein engineering. It has a robust R&D system with nearly 4,000 personnel and invests heavily in developing precise nutrition databases, functional feed additives, microbial fermentation feed technologies, and antibiotic alternatives. Production methods emphasize localized manufacturing near key farming regions, centralized raw material procurement combined with local sourcing, and integrated technical service support to optimize feed formulations and farming outcomes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haid Group serves a diverse customer base including commercial livestock and aquaculture farmers, integrated farming companies, and food producers. Its products cater to pig, poultry (chicken, duck, goose), aquatic species (shrimp, fish), and ruminants. The company targets both domestic Chinese markets and international markets in Southeast Asia, South America, Africa, and other regions, focusing on customers requiring high-quality feed, premium seedlings, and comprehensive farming solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with major presence in South China, East China, North China, and Central China. Internationally, it has established manufacturing and sales operations in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Bangladesh), South America (Ecuador), Africa (Egypt, Nigeria), and other emerging markets. Its global footprint includes over 200 cities across Asia, Africa, and South America, supporting a broad international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Haid Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the animal husbandry supply chain. It manufactures feed and animal health products, breeds and supplies premium animal seedlings, and engages in farming operations. The company integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream feed production, technical services, and farming, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the animal agriculture value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on expanding feed production capacity domestically and internationally, enhancing R&D capabilities in animal genetics, nutrition, and health, and developing integrated farming solutions. It emphasizes innovation in microbial fermentation feed, antibiotic alternatives, functional health feeds, and precision nutrition. Haid Group also invests in breeding technologies for shrimp and fish, aiming to lead industry advancements and support sustainable, healthy farming practices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of animal feed, seedlings, animal health products, and farmed livestock and aquatic products. The company also earns income from trade of raw materials and related services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with integrated technical and farming services enhancing customer value and retention.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haid Group is one of the leading feed producers in China and globally, ranking among the top three Chinese feed companies worldwide. It competes with other major domestic and international feed manufacturers, particularly in the highly competitive Chinese market and emerging overseas markets. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D, integrated product and service offerings, and extensive geographic coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 114.6 billion, a slight decrease of 1.31% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 64.3% to about RMB 4.5 billion. Total assets grew by 7.58% to RMB 48.1 billion, and net assets increased by 21.67% to RMB 23.9 billion. Feed sales volume rose by 8.7% to 26.5 million tons, with overseas sales growing 40%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding domestic and international operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Haid Group emphasizes its comprehensive value proposition of providing integrated animal husbandry solutions combining high-quality feed, premium seedlings, and animal health products with advanced farming technologies and services. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong R&D capabilities, extensive product portfolio, localized production and service networks, and ability to deliver tailored, science-based solutions that improve animal health, growth efficiency, and farming profitability while supporting sustainable and healthy farming practices.
